name: Gouda Studios Agent Tools
description: Agent-payable data tools (SAM.gov, SEC EDGAR, USAspending, GLEIF, website contact extractor, YouTube transcript extractor) via Apify's hosted MCP server.

authentication.description: Sign in with Apify OAuth (authorization server https://console-backend.apify.com) or send an Apify API token as Authorization: Bearer <token>. tools/list is open; tools/call returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate until authenticated.

tools.name: get-actor-run
tools.title: Get Actor run
tools.description: Returns status, storages, stats, and a short summary for one Actor run. Use after starting a run, or with waitSecs to wait for a terminal status.

waitSecs.description: Seconds to wait for the run to finish (0-45).

tools.name: get-dataset-items
tools.title: Get dataset items
tools.description: Returns rows from a dataset produced by an Actor run. Use when you have a datasetId and need the result items.

clean.description: If true, skip empty items and hidden fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

desc.description: If true, return newest items first.

tools.name: get-key-value-store-record
tools.title: Get key-value store record
tools.description: Returns one record from a key-value store by store id and record key. Use for INPUT, OUTPUT, or other named records.

tools.name: abort-actor-run
tools.title: Abort Actor run
tools.description: Requests abort of an Actor run that is starting or running. No effect if the run already finished.

gracefully.description: If true, request a graceful abort.

tools.name: gouda_studios--sam-gov-opportunities-feed
tools.title: gouda_studios/sam-gov-opportunities-feed
tools.description: Returns SAM.gov federal contract opportunities as JSON, filterable by keyword, NAICS, set-aside, notice type, agency, and state. Use for new or matching notices.

inputSchema.title: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities Feed

minDaysUntilResponse.description: Minimum days remaining until response deadline.

includeDetails.description: If true, fetch full notice details.

includeContacts.description: If true, include contracting officer contacts.

onlyNew.description: If true, return only notices not seen before.

waitSecs.description: Seconds to wait for the run to finish (0-45).
